description: Pin the fro-bot/agent action to its v0.x release line.
fro-bot/agent also publishes @fro.bot/harness binaries as GitHub Releases in the same repo.
Releases tagged before 2026-08-29 use SemVer build metadata (1.18.21+harness.<sha>), which is
ignored for precedence, so the github-tags datasource reads them as stable 1.18.x and ranks them
above the real v0.x action line. Newer harness tags use a prerelease identifier (-harness.<sha>)
and are excluded by ignoreUnstable, but the older tags stay stable-shaped permanently: deleting
them would 404 the asset URLs that shipped action versions build from their own bundled code.
This cap is the durable guard for consumers. Lift it only when the action itself reaches 1.0.
